svg.title: Vale's four planes
svg.desc: A screen of Vale pulled apart into the four planes the console stacks to draw it, numbered from back to front. 1, the ground layer, BG3: grass, water and paths. 2, the middle layer, BG2: walls and edges. 3, the sprites: Isaac and the other actors. 4, the overhead layer, BG1: what is drawn over them. The console draws them in this order, so Isaac stands in front of the middle layer and behind the overhead one.
svg.text: VALE, PULLED APART: BACK TO FRONT
Isaac is drawn between planes 2 and 4: in
front of the middle layer, behind the overhead one.
